findings.issue: The Failure Triage says "a fan-out lineage skips `phase_init` and would start with no nodes". The code does not do that. Each lineage prompt tells it to "Run phase_init, phase_main_loop ... and phase_synthesis" (fanout-run.cjs:1823). Inside phase_init, the lineage skips only step_frontier_seed and step_frontier_budget, through `skip_when: config.fanout_lineage_artifact_dir is present` (deep-research.yaml:758 and :778). The lineage gets its nodes from fanout-run.cjs instead. The step that never reaches phase_init is the fan-out parent, which jumps from step_fanout_spawn to phase_synthesis (deep-research.yaml:349-351). That is why the seed has to run before the spawn.

evidence.cmd: rg -n 'Run phase_init, phase_main_loop' .skilled/skills/system-deep-loop/runtime/scripts/fanout-run.cjs; rg -n 'skip_when: "config.fanout_lineage_artifact_dir is present"' .skilled/commands/deep/assets/deep-research.yaml
evidence.out:
1823:    `Run phase_init, phase_main_loop (${stopClause}), and phase_synthesis.`,
758:        skip_when: "config.fanout_lineage_artifact_dir is present"

fix.old: because a fan-out lineage skips `phase_init` and would start with no nodes.
fix.new: because the fan-out parent jumps from `step_fanout_spawn` to `phase_synthesis` without reaching `phase_init`, and each lineage skips its own `phase_init` seed, so the lineages would start with no nodes.

findings.issue: The objective says "each lineage store exists before its lineage spawns". In the code, writeLineageFrontierStore returns false and writes no store when a lineage is dealt no node. It also writes nothing when the lineage already has a store, as on a resume (fanout-run.cjs:380). When there are more lineages than open seed nodes, the extra lineages never get a store. fanout-run.cjs:395-403 prints a warning for exactly this case.

The doc says fanout-run "writes each lineage's `frontier-nodes.jsonl` and inbox rows before it spawns". The code writes them only for a lineage that was dealt at least one node and has no store yet (fanout-run.cjs:380). A lineage with a zero share gets no store and no inbox rows, and it runs at its loop default budget.

The doc says "`runtime/scripts/fanout-run.cjs` writes each fan-out lineage's starting store before the lineage spawns". The code skips the store for a lineage dealt no node, and for a lineage that already has a store (fanout-run.cjs:380).

The doc says "Global recovery runs only when no node is open." In the workflow, the frontier close branch fires only when the latest iteration focus contains 'Frontier node <id>' and that node is open or active (deep-research.yaml:1476). Otherwise it falls through to global recovery. resolveNextFocus can return a blocked-stop recovery focus or a divergence pivot focus ahead of the frontier focus (deep-research/scripts/reduce-state.cjs:2558-2590). After such an iteration, global recovery runs even while frontier nodes are still open.

evidence.cmd: rg -n 'when: "depth_mode == .expansive. AND the latest iteration focus' .skilled/commands/deep/assets/deep-research.yaml
evidence.out: 1476:            when: "depth_mode == 'expansive' AND the latest iteration focus contains 'Frontier node <id>' AND that node is open or active in registry.frontier.nodes"

findings.issue: The doc lists the budget sources that always win over the seed-derived budget: "An explicit `--max-iterations`, marker or fan-out matrix `iterations` value always wins". The list leaves out the setup answer. In the workflow, max_iterations_source is default only when none of the flag, the marker, the setup answer or a single-lineage matrix value set it (deep-research.yaml:72). seedBudget and step_frontier_budget derive a budget only for the default source.
